# assistassets-ai

Canonical organization: https://github.com/assistassets-ai

assistassets-ai hosts local-first software for finance-oriented analysis, evidence review, and assistant workflows. Public projects should be described as exploratory software or workflow support, not as financial, tax, legal, accounting, or investment advice.

## Public repositories

- https://github.com/assistassets-ai/FinancialProof
  - Local-first Streamlit tool for historical financial market pattern analysis.
  - Topics and search phrases: local-first financial analysis, Streamlit finance tool, market data exploration, technical indicators, ARIMA, Monte Carlo, sentiment analysis, SQLite state, no trading advice.

- https://github.com/assistassets-ai/.github
  - Organization profile, community files, and machine-readable context for assistassets-ai.
  - The visible GitHub organization profile is `profile/README.md`.

## Risk boundary

assistassets-ai projects are not financial advisers, not trading systems, not tax advisers, not legal advisers, and not substitutes for professional review. Treat generated output as exploratory analysis or workflow context only.
